We help humans understand humans.

Pulp is a research company in Brooklyn. We study how people talk, argue and make up their minds, and we build tools around what we learn: Thinkwell for the people whose work runs on conversation, typodojo for anyone who wants to draw letters, and a platform underneath both.

Read what we are working on at pulp.com.ai.

posts.alt: Technology doesn’t make you a better thinker. It never has. Habits do.
posts.caption:
Technology doesn’t make you a better thinker. It never has. Habits do.

So we measure what actually helps: critical thinking, reflection, and conversations that change minds on both sides. Walking away solves nothing.

The full essay is at pulp.com.ai.

#criticalThinking #metacognition #habits

posts.alt: From afar, up close, from every angle. People at large scale. One person at one moment. How and why people decide.
posts.caption:
Three ways we look at people.

From afar: people at large scale, one graph across time, past and present. Up close: one person at one moment, who they are, what they care about, their state of mind and their surroundings. From every angle: how and why people think and decide, in numbers for machines and in words for people.

More at pulp.com.ai.

#research #people #decisions

posts.alt: Two SDKs on one engine. The Pulp API on the server. Loosethreads on the web.
posts.caption:
Two SDKs, one engine.

Everything we make runs on one parameterized language for people and machines. Developers reach it two ways: the Pulp API on the server, with Radiance, Windfall, TrueAura and Groundwater, and Loosethreads on the web, with weftConversations, WarpDisplays, DyeMedia and BightInteractions.

The platform is at pulp.com.ai/platform.

Everything we make runs on one parameterized language for people and machines. Developers reach it two ways: the Pulp API on the server, with Radiance, Windfall, TrueAura and Groundwater, and Loosethreads on the web, with weftConversations, WarpDisplays, DyeMedia and BightInteractions.

The platform is at pulp.com.ai/platform.
